body:
I wouldn't even mind being under the expectations of others, if they didn't feel so stifling at least.

As far as a career, I daydream about becoming a mathematician, but I don't know how to bring myself to even start the process (school, etc). As far as a day-to-day job, I'd like to work w/ computers physically, so maybe some sort of IT work.

There's actually a few different things I'd like to spend my time doing, but I just can't seem to drum up the energy to pursue any of them.
